fields.title: Faces remain elastic
fields.issue: Neither beryllium nor stainless faces yield in the model. Beryllium inheritednu=.33 is used for comparison, not a verified grade-specific value. Known strength-basis uncertainty of021 is not resolved by these stability runs. NASA CR194164 Table2 reports SR200 in-plane nu12=.0768 andnu21=.0752 for1.96mm sheet. Treating.0768 isotropically at the lead gauge is itself a transfer. Its strong-direction endpoint98.34692kPa leaves only3.02% over operating pressure. A declared.03 sensitivity for021 gives91.468265kPa, below operating pressure. At the baseline endpoints, outer-face maximum equivalent stresses are660.806/835.808MPa for021 W/L and1144.503/1303.532MPa for021b W/L. These are von Mises diagnostics, not a verified beryllium criterion. Face survival to these loads is not established.
